WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT 
    oe.ordersmark, 
    o.timespan, 
    AVG(oe.fillcount) as order_avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions oe
  INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  WHERE oe.fillcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
),
timespan_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    timespan, 
    AVG(order_avg_fill) as timespan_avg
  FROM order_fills
  GROUP BY timespan
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    of.ordersmark,
    of.timespan,
    of.order_avg_fill,
    ta.timespan_avg,
    of.order_avg_fill - ta.timespan_avg as above_avg,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY of.timespan ORDER BY of.order_avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST) as rank
  FROM order_fills of
  JOIN timespan_avgs ta ON of.timespan = ta.timespan
  WHERE of.order_avg_fill > ta.timespan_avg
)
SELECT 
  ordersmark,
  timespan,
  order_avg_fill,
  above_avg,
  rank
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY timespan, rank
